fields.statement: Which intent should change set 01M6MBPT (Ship-change fixes red PR CI) serve? It follows up #259 (agents run only scoped tests, so CI runs the full suite), and #259's change set served milestone-25 (the daemon empties the backlog on its own) and milestone-24. / How should a red PR CI become a fix in ship-change? Today pr-green/rebased-green/landed-green/rebased-merge-green run `rhiza ship check`, which reruns failed jobs once per head and then fails the run. / Which failing ship-check stages get a CI-fix cycle, and where does the run go after the fix? / What cap should CI-fix cycles have before the run fails?
